blocks.content: You've created and verified a silence in Grafana Alerting.

**What you accomplished:**

- Navigated to the Silences page
- Created a silence with label matchers and a time window
- Verified the silence is active and suppressing matching alerts
- Learned how to end a silence early and manage expired silences

**Silences vs. mute timings:**

| | Silences | Mute timings |
|---|----------|---------------|
| Scope | Label-matched alerts | Policy-level |
| Duration | One-time (fixed window) | Recurring |
| Use case | Maintenance, known outages | Weekends, quiet hours |

To set up recurring suppression, try the **Configure a mute timing** learning path.
